mapper.sql: f.id AS food_id, f.name AS food_name, f.latitude, f.longitude, f.address, f.summary, f.story, f.ingredients, f.image_url, f.remark, f.heat, f.review_status, f.reviewed_by, f.reviewed_at, f.created_by, f.created_at, r.id AS region_id, r.name AS region_name, r.province AS region_province, r.description AS region_description
mapper.select: SELECT FROM food f INNER JOIN region r ON r.id = f.region_id WHERE f.created_by = #{username} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE food SET name = #{name}, region_id = #{regionId}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, address = #{address}, summary = #{summary}, story = #{story}, ingredients = #{ingredients}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, remark = #{remark}, review_status = #{status}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'APPROVED' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{id} AND created_by = #{username}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM food WHERE review_status = 'PENDING'
SELECT FROM food f INNER JOIN region r ON r.id = f.region_id WHERE f.id = #{id} AND f.review_status = 'APPROVED'
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO food_daily_visit (food_id, user_id, visit_date, visited_at) SELECT f.id, u.id, CURRENT_DATE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM food f INNER JOIN app_user u ON u.username = #{username} AND u.active = TRUE WHERE f.id = #{foodId} AND f.review_status = 'APPROVED'
mapper.select: SELECT , v.visited_at AS footprint_visited_at FROM food_daily_visit v INNER JOIN app_user u ON u.id = v.user_id INNER JOIN food f ON f.id = v.food_id INNER JOIN region r ON r.id = f.region_id WHERE u.username = #{username} AND f.review_status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY v.visited_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM food f INNER JOIN region r ON r.id = f.region_id WHERE f.review_status = 'APPROVED'
AND r.province LIKE CONCAT('%', #{province}, '%')
AND r.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{city}, '%')
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM food_daily_visit seen INNER JOIN app_user seen_user ON seen_user.id = seen.user_id WHERE seen.food_id = f.id AND seen_user.username = #{username} AND seen.visited_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 30 DAY )
ORDER BY
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM food_daily_visit preference INNER JOIN app_user preference_user ON preference_user.id = preference.user_id INNER JOIN food viewed_food ON viewed_food.id = preference.food_id WHERE preference_user.username = #{username} AND preference.visited_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 30 DAY AND viewed_food.region_id = f.region_id ) DESC,
f.heat DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE food SET review_status = #{status}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND review_status = 'PENDING'
